opening.speech: Mending. Same net. There is a fortnight of this in every net and a fortnight of my life in every fortnight.

choices.text: What do people here say about the beacon?

beacon.speech: They say the weather. They say it was probably wet wood. It was not wet wood — I have been up there and it goes up like a torch in March. But saying so out loud puts a name in the square, and half of us are related to the name.

name.speech: Ask the reeve and hold the tally up while you do it. That is what it is for. I mend nets.
